name: Launch Complex 39B
best_known_for: Apollo 10 + Skylab + 53 Shuttle flights; now NASA's SLS / Artemis pad
credit: Sister pad to 39A at NASA Kennedy Space Center. Apollo 10 + Skylab + 53 Shuttle missions through 2006. Converted to clean-pad configuration in 2007; from 2022 onward serves Artemis I and the SLS Block 1 / Block 1B for the lunar return programme. Coordinates and operational history from NASA KSC fact sheets.
